title: Integral tensor and pullback coordinates
statement: Fix a prime l, a scheme X, its native ordinary realization R and a finite coefficient index E. For a normalized finite tensor presentation N, finiteIntegralTensorMap is N.ordinary.inv followed by scalar extension of N.completion.comparison on the two integral inputs. For an isomorphism g:X→Y and an IntegralReindex V, finiteIntegralPullMap is V.derived.hom followed by scalar extension of podCompletedToTowerIso.hom. integralStagePullIso composes the literal common-stage and rational pullback object identifications. integralStageTensorIso composes inclusion of the inverse rational tensor object identification with the specified stageTensor. These are explicit composites of the maps of [def-sf-native-adic-finite-normalization], [def-sf-native-adic-reindexing-data], [def-sf-common-stage-inclusion-tensor-comparison] and [def-sf-adic-completed-tensor-finite-models], with no new choices.

def finiteIntegralTensorMap (X : Scheme.{u})
    (R : LocallyFiniteAdicRealization.Realization l X)
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)] (A : At l X R)
    (E : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l (PadicAlgCl l))
    (N : FiniteNormalization l X R A E)
    (K L : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l
      (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X) :
    A.closed.tensor.obj
      ((pbcDerivedExtend (coefficientMap l X R E)).obj K.obj,
       (pbcDerivedExtend (coefficientMap l X R E)).obj L.obj) ⟶
    (pbcDerivedExtend (coefficientMap l X R E)).obj
      ((constructibleIntegralTensor l
        (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X).obj
        (K, L)).obj
